residual: The exact optimal parameter region or dimension-dependent exceptions beyond this sufficient range are not determined by the present counterexample.
first_step: Start a separate task with the saved2×2 rational family and Ricard introduction; state a fixed p,s,r optimization problem before testing whether every p<s admits a counterexample.
